compRules.help: A rule decides the coupon a complaint gets by default. On a new ticket the agent sees it pre-filled and can accept, adjust or switch it off; a ticket from Yiji without a coupon gets it automatically. Every coupon still waits for a WeCare supervisor’s approval. When several rules match, the most specific one wins, then the highest priority.
compRules.loadError: Could not load the rules. If this environment was just updated, the compensation_rules collection may not be applied yet.
compRules.emptyHelp: Until a rule exists nothing is pre-filled for agents, and tickets from Yiji get no automatic coupon. Add the first rule from the ops compensation policy.
compRules.deleteHelp: Coupons it already produced are kept; they simply stop naming a rule. To pause a rule instead, turn it off.
compRules.limitHelp: Optional. When on, a customer who already had this many rule coupons in the window gets no new one from a rule (rejected coupons do not count). An agent can still request a coupon by hand.
compRules.editorHelp: The coupon this rule suggests. A supervisor still approves every coupon.
compRules.priorityHint: Higher wins when two equally specific rules match.
compRules.fNoOther: Cannot be combined with other discounts
